notes.title: New Big Update 0.25
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Many technical, mechanical and cosmetic improvements have been made since the game was released.

Improvements were made with the feedback from the community and the items in the developer roadmap.

I've been working on a major and binding version update for about three months.
In this version update, the infrastructure that we will go to the main scenario has been developed.

Cosmetic improvements were made to the opening animation, tutorial scene, quest system, NPCs, swimming, underwater diving mechanics and map design.

In addition to these, minor and major grades were improved.
First of all, to give you all the details of the improvements made in the big update.

Then I would like to explain the minor and major items.

Opening Scene
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/MintyHeftyAmurstarfish-size_restricted.gif
Improved the animation scene for the beginning of the story.
(Scene will be completed with an after update.)

Tutorial Sequence
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ViciousSoupyBrocketdeer-size_restricted.gif
In line with the main story, the NPC named Old Man, who found the character we gave life to when we landed on the island and gave him information about the island and introduced the game, was added to the game and the tutorial sequence was developed.

[olist]
 About lakes (water sources),
 About trees and plants
 About the resources
 Hunger - about thirst,
 About saving the game
[/olist]
gives a lot of information.

New Village
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111415/ea8ba9b03722f5698e8323771f55a7ecb790537e.png
A settlement named “Old Man Village” has been added to the game.

Quest System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111415/e17bc873173fe291ab9703f6e7afeaa392c788d5.png
Now our game supports Quest and NPC infrastructure.

 Old Man
 Villager Woman

In this village, which is close to the beach in the north of the map, progress can be made in the game by taking tasks from NPCs.

A Quest panel has been developed.
After opening the inventory with the Tab key, the Quest menu can be accessed by pressing the "Quests" button in the upper right section.
[olist]
 Quests that are active are indicated by a blank red star.
 Completed quests are indicated by a green solid star.
[/olist]
The quests to be done and in proggress the whole scenario can be viewed on this screen.
When a quest is received, quest progress and quest gifts can be viewed on this screen.

There are currently 4 missions in total.
Main quests will be added with future updates.
Currently, the side and starter quests required to go to the main quests are on the quest screen.

New Inventory Interface
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111415/3bfe19956d881ecd135050ce0b087a0cd399fc60.png
A new button group has been added to the upper part of the inventory interface.
With this button group, quick access to the Large Map and Mission menu can be provided.

Diving Mechanics and Underwater World Design
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/OrneryHiddenDogwoodclubgall-size_restricted.gif
Added 2 coastlines on the map. (Additional cosmetic enhancements will continue for beaches.)
The underwater diving feature has been improved.
The first step was taken for the underwater world's rocks, algae and fish ecosystem.

 General Map Cosmetic Improvements
 Added stones around lakes.
 Sharp peaks and corners have been made softer.
 Trees near the water have been relocated.

(The mechanics of diving and returning to shore will be made more stable in future updates.)

Health Bar
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/PertinentInsecureConch-size_restricted.gif
Added a health indicator over enemies and animals.
When an attack is made and a hit is made, the health indicator is visible.
When a creature dies, the health indicator disappears.

Added New Features
General UI
[olist]
 Inventory interface top menu group has been development. (Inventory, Large Map, Quest Panel) rapid transition between screens was provided.
 Added "Suicide" button in Escape Menu.
 "Exit" button has been added to the map.
[/olist]

GamePlay
[olist]
 Items no longer disappear after death.
When you go to the place where you died, your belongings are in the box.
 Improved the feature that the food and water values decrease faster when the character is running. 
 The days were made longer than the nights.
 Bush Tree stick/berry collection amount was shown on the screen.
 The names of the mines, information messages and excavation quantities were shown on the screen.
 The information message of the tree and the cutting amount were shown on the screen.
 Added dust cloud particle effect after resource are broken.
 Added Health Bar on animals.
 Added Health Bar on enemies.
[/olist]

Rendering
[olist]
 Night dark level lowered.
[/olist]

Fixes & Changes
[olist]
 Fixed the bug of eating from hudBar when the map is open.
 Active status animals were removed from the game for a while due to a problem with their combat mechanics.
 When the Escape menu is opened, the information text in the middle of the screen is hidden.
 Adding items to LootCreate has been deactivated.
 After the Save/Load operation, setting the tool/weapon durability value to 100 has been fixed.
 Prevented animals from appearing in the Large Map.
 The minimap has been removed from the game.
[/olist]

Dev Notes
[olist]
 The build version has been increased.
 Supported languages other than English have been removed for a while.
[/olist]

notes.title: Upcoming Big Update 0.25
notes.content:
Hello there,

Developments for the big update have been going on for about three months.

The improvements for the first major update to be released have been completed.
Many new features and mechanics have been added in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111415/0ecabb5026fa7b7dfa9b1c9eac1484eeaeb627bd.png

Fixed cosmetic and minor bugs based on feedback from the community.
Minor and major issues in the developer notes were corrected and additions were made.

As of now, end-user tests are carried out.
A major update will be released in a few days after the tests are successful.

Before the major update, the sale price of the game was changed.

A special thank you to each and every one of you for your support from the community during this time.

Best regards.

notes.title: About The Big Update #2
notes.content:
Hello there,

The first major update works continue successfully.

Changes were made to the general story and concept designs.
The new opening sequence will be completed soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111415/8bde73936783beb6276112cb1d022be4f3c9cd81.png

In the world of "The Octots", when we start the game, the person known as the "Old Man" welcomes us and gives us information about the world. (Tutorial dialog sequence is ready)

Release date Steam christmas event!
I wish you good games.

notes.title: About The Big Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

As you know, since the game's first release, feedback from the community and improvements to the items in the developer roadmap have been carried out regularly.

Currently, the game has a stable and bug-free version.
I would like to inform you that a major update is being worked on.

Main story, side quests, characters (npc), new world design, villages, roads and dialogues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111415/1de737eef26c2746f39f2ee7b161f7b93acd5004.png

Since there will be many new feature developments and add-ons, both the development process and post-development testing will take time.

That's why I wanted to share this announcement with you in order to prevent the community from getting news about the game and not creating a quiet environment.

Although it is not clear yet, I would like to release the first major update package for the 2021 year.

If you had a good time playing the game during this time, please leave a positive comment on the store page and help us reach more players.

All your feedback about the game is very valuable to me.
You can contact me on the game community page and send your suggestions and requests.

I wish everyone good games.

notes.title: New Update 0.05
notes.content:
Hello there,

In the Version 0.05 update, a study was carried out that included the items in the developer roadmap.

In line with the feedback from the community and players, our game was translated into different languages.
If there is a translation error you see, please share it with us under the community, we will make changes quickly and regularly.

A large map feature has been developed to find where we are in the game's world and to see enemies and resources from a bird's eye view.

Studies are being carried out on Steam achievements and new achievement ideas are being worked on every day.
A few new essential and must-have achievements have been added in this version.

Added New Features
Languages
1. English
2. Turkish
3. German
4. Italian

Achievements
Survive 1 day
Survive 5 day
Survive 10 day
Survive 25 day
Survive 50 day
Survive 100 day

General UI
1. Added animation to main menu camera.
2. Changed main menu mouse cursor icon.

GamePlay
1. Added water value to blueberries.
2. Spawn point changed to lakeside.

Map System
1. Improved the in-game large map feature. (You can open it with the "M" key.)
2. On the large map, the player is shown in green.
3. On the large map, the enemy is shown in red.
4. You can navigate on the map with the movement keys and return to the current player's location with the "focus" button.
5. The lakes are shown on the map.
6. Mine are shown on the map according to their types.

How to change language
a. Open Steam and click on your Library tab.
b. Locate the game you want to change the language for in your Game list.
c. Right-click on the game name and select properties.
d. Click on the language tab and select your desired language.

notes.title: Upcoming Update 0.05
notes.content:
Hello there,

After the version 0.04 update, I continue to work on the issues included in the developer roadmap.
The new 0.05 update will include multi-language support, new achievements, in-game map and minor improvements.

The version will be published after the tests are carried out after the developments.

I wish everyone good games.

notes.title: Upcoming Update 0.04
notes.content:
Hello there,

After the version 0.3 update, I started working on version 0.4 with the plans on the developer roadmap and feedback from the community.

Our game now supports the Steam achievement system.
This update will cover audio settings tweaks and bug fixes.

I am creating a hot-fix infrastructure to quickly fix a bug that may occur in the future.

After the work on the update is completed, it will be published after the improvements and edits are tested.

Remember, the game is still in early access, please share all your feedback with me.

Thank you for purchasing and supporting my game.

notes.title: New Update 0.03
notes.content:
Hello to everyone,

After the first official update, I released a new comprehensive version 0.3 update, with community feedback and items in the developer roadmap.

In this version update, there are many more adjustments and innovations in artificial intelligence, interface, rendering, lighting and gameplay.

Weapons and tools now have durability.
There is a more stable and synchronous combat mechanic with enemies and animals.
There are new lights and fog available to let you feel the world of "The Octots".

Remember, the game is still in early access, please don't forget to share with me any suggestions you have in mind and any experiences you have in the community center discussions tab.
I regularly follow feedback from the community.

Added New Features
GamePlay
1. Added durability to tools and weapons.
2. Tree cutting time has been shortened by two-tenths.
3. Ore mining time has been extended by two-tenths.
4. Improved the enemy loot feature. (Enemy gives items according to their difficulty level.)
5. Added time slot to hitting and swinging moves.
6. When you hit it with a hand tool or weapon, the character will stop walking.

Sound
1. The sound effect has been played when transferring items from Storage Box, campfire, furnace to inventory.
2. Game sounds stopped playing while the Escape menu was active.

Rendering
1. Added fog effect to main menu background.
2. Added three unique fog effect to in game. (Morning, Day, Night)
3. Changed "Minimap" map angle and effect.
4. Terrain texture quality changed normal to high quality
5. Added attack trail effect to weapons and hand tools.

Inventory UI
1. Added item durability information to Inventory, item detail window.
2. Added animation effect to Storage Box Panel opening.
3. Added animation effect to Crafting Panel opening.
4. Added animation effect to Sleeping Panel opening.
5. Made the crafting panel pop up automatically when inventory is opened.
 
General UI
1. An early access notification message has been added to the main menu.
2. Animation has been added to the opening of the Escape menu, graphic options, game options, audio options panel screens.
3. The Crosshair image has been replaced with a new image.

Fixes
GamePlay
1. Made fixes for removing objects with the construction hammer.
2. Fixed changing items with the mouse wheel while the inventory is open.
3. "Hunting Knife" has been removed from the weapons category and added to the tools category and the crafting recipe has been changed.
4. The distance of the player to hit the animal has been expanded.

AI
1. Fixed the problem of enemies and animals passing through walls. (For all buildable items fixed.)
2. When an enemy kills you and you respawn, they will no longer follow you again.
3. Enemy run speed decreased.
4. Fixed the issue where the enemy object dragged by hitting the character. (Collisions have been restructured.)
5. The walking and running speeds of animals have been reduced.
6. Increased the time for animals to change direction when escaping from the player.

UI
1. When the Escape menu is active, opening the inventory with the tab key is prevented.
2. Fixed the "Crosshair" disappearing issue when pressing the "Back to game" button in the "Escape menu".

Dev Notes
1. CameraShake component reference change to singleton.
2. CraftingManager component reference change to singleton.
3. BowManager component reference change to singleton.
4. BuildingManager component reference change to singleton.
5. CharacterMovement component reference change to singleton.
6. InventoryExtension reference change to singleton.
7. PlayerInventoryItemManager component reference change to singleton.
8. SleepingManager component reference change to singleton.
9. EscapeMenu component reference change to singleton.
10. MouseCursor component reference change to singleton.
11. CameraFollow component reference change to singleton.
12. The build version has been increased.

notes.title: Upcoming Update 0.03
notes.content:
Hello there,

In the version 0.2 update, many problems have been solved and many changes have been made around the world.

In this update, many changes and fixes were made on artificial intelligence, interface and gameplay.
We are currently working on the development of the final items and the testing of the currently completed items.

Until the new update announcement, I wanted to share the notes about some items with you.

AI Changes & Fixes
1. Fixed collision errors when fighting enemies.
2. Improved the walking speed, hit times and decision mechanisms of the enemies.
3. Enemies can no longer pass through structures.
4. The running and decision-making mechanics of the animals were revised.
5. And more.

Serious work has been done in this version to create a better gameplay feeling for you.
Remember, the game is still in early access, please share all your feedback with me.

I continue to work uninterruptedly to do better with each new version.
Thank you for purchasing and supporting my game.
